sloka: प्रक्षाल्य वदनं हृष्टः स्नातः परमभूषितः ।पिपासुस्त्वरयामास पानं बलसमीरणम् ।। ६.६०.९२ ।।।।
transliteration: prakṣālya vadanaṁ hṛṣṭaḥ snātaḥ paramabhūṣitaḥ ।pipāsustvarayāmāsa pānaṁ balasamīraṇam ।। 6.60.92 ।।।।

translations.english: (Kumbhakarna) Having drunk two thousand pots of wine, slightly excited and inebriated and replenished with strength and energy was ready to depart.
